results.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight above your shoulder, with the knee on the same side bent.
Roll onto your opposite forearm, then hand, keeping the bell locked out overhead.
Lift your hips, sweep your straight leg under you into a kneeling position, and stand up.
Reverse every step with control back to lying down.
tips: Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Learn the movement with a light weight or no weight first.
results.description: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Quadriceps, Triceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
instructions: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a kettlebell handle and the other on the floor.
Do a push-up.
Move your hands so the other hand goes onto the kettlebell, walking over it.
Do another push-up and keep alternating.
tips: Keep your body in a straight line.
Make sure the kettlebell is stable before putting weight on it.
results.description: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and turn your feet about 45 degrees away from that side.
Keeping your eyes on the bell, push your hips out to the side of the raised arm.
Hinge and slide your free hand down the inside of your front leg toward the floor.
Return to standing by driving your hips back under you, keeping the bell locked out.
tips: Keep your top arm vertical throughout.
Only go as low as your hamstrings allow.
results.description: Kettlebell Windmill is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes, Core.

results.name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your head to the floor or a pad, then bring your knees down toward your chest.
Kick your legs up explosively while pressing hard with your arms to lock out.
Lower with control and repeat.
tips: Master strict handstand push-ups and wall handstands first.
Use a pad under your head.
results.description: Kipping Handstand Push-Up is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest, Core, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge and Twist
instructions: Stand facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
In the lunge, rotate your torso to bring the bar toward the side of your front leg.
Rotate back, stand up and repeat on the other leg.
tips: Keep your front knee over your foot.
Rotate from your torso, not your hips.
results.description: Landmine Alternating Lunge and Twist is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge to Chest Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
As you lower, press the bar forward and up until your arms are straight.
Bring the bar back to your chest, stand up and repeat with the other leg.
tips: Keep your torso upright in the lunge.
Brace your core during the press.
results.description: Landmine Alternating Lunge to Chest Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Rotational Lift to Press
instructions: Stand side-on to the landmine and hold the end of the bar beside your hip with both hands.
Squat slightly and rotate toward the bar.
Drive from your legs and rotate your torso to lift the bar across your body.
Press it overhead on the opposite side, then reverse with control.
tips: Pivot your back foot as you rotate.
Power comes from your legs and hips.
results.description: Landmine Rotational Lift to Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Quadriceps, Triceps.

results.name: Lateral Sled Drag
instructions: Attach a rope or strap to the sled and stand side-on to it, holding the strap.
Bend your knees into a quarter squat.
Step sideways away from the sled, dragging it with each step.
Continue for the set distance, then switch to lead with the other side.
tips: Stay low and don't cross your feet.
Keep your torso upright.
results.description: Lateral Sled Drag is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Adductors, Core.

results.name: Low Box Lateral Runner
instructions: Stand beside a low box or step.
Step one foot onto the box.
Quickly run sideways over the box, switching feet with each step.
Continue moving side to side for the set time.
tips: Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your steps quick and light.
results.description: Low Box Lateral Runner is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Abductors, Adductors.

results.name: Low Box Quick Feet
instructions: Stand facing a low box or step.
Tap one foot onto the box, then the other, in quick succession.
Keep alternating taps as fast as you can with control.
Continue for the set time.
tips: Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms to keep the rhythm.
results.description: Low Box Quick Feet is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.
